summary: Limit instance or container groups with max_concurrent_jobs and max_forks. For container groups: max jobs = workers × CPU per worker / pod CPU request (2 CPU at 250m = 8), and max forks = workers × memory per worker / pod memory request; task impact is forks + 1.
questions: How do I calculate max_concurrent_jobs for a container group?
How do I set max_forks on an instance group?
How do I limit jobs on OpenShift container groups?

answer_card.title: Size a container group
answer_card.answer_md:
```text
max_concurrent_jobs = (worker nodes * CPU per worker) / pod_spec CPU request
max_forks           = (worker nodes * memory per worker) / pod_spec memory request
```
Example: 1 worker with 2 CPU, pods request 250m CPU gives 8 jobs. Each job uses forks + 1. Set both on the instance or container group.
